description: An opt-in statement that a federation publisher (spec 09) offers coverage in an area (spec 10 section 6). The record key is the publisher's Nostr public key in hex.

nostrPubkey.description: Publisher key, 64 lowercase hex digits. MUST equal the record key.

geohash.description: Approximate area. At most 5 characters (about 5 km).

downlinks.description: Whether the publisher accepts downlink requests.
